framework_profile.framework: Multi-component: skill-runtime (Python package/CLI, argparse + uv entrypoints) + hook-plane (Claude Code command hooks, bounded JSON stdin / event-specific stdout-exit protocol, cli_command surface) + authority-client (injected outbound transports)
framework_profile.framework_version: Python >=3.14 (ecosystem-policy migration, W0 coordinated); Claude Code >=2.1.199,<3; rfc8785==0.1.4; cryptography==49.0.0; fcntl LOCK_SH/LOCK_EX direct; filelock>=3.20.3,<4 legacy writers only
enabled_features: fcntl.flock shared/exclusive locking (LOCK_SH readers, LOCK_EX writers); filelock legacy writers only
ed25519 signature VERIFICATION + purpose-scoped TrustPolicy authorization (signing lives in operator/fizzy authority domains)
Claude Code command hooks (parallel execution; single slice dispatcher per event; JSON-on-exit-0 xor exit-2/stderr)
fizzy MCP consumed contracts (capability-probed) incl. evidence-snapshot-registration-v1

subprofiles.data_access_model: file-backed JSON/JSONL registries under .adversarial-spec/ with envelope validation; authoritative registries over prose views
subprofiles.mutation_model: CLI commands with deterministic exit codes; hook stdio decisions; REMOTE mutations only via consumed fizzy contracts
subprofiles.cache_model: content-hash staleness (normalized semantic form excludes content_hash+generated_at); frozen-node hash pins; no in-memory cache layer
subprofiles.error_model: named fail-closed result enums (RemoteOperationResult, PromotionSequenceResult) + exit codes 0/1/2 + validation Envelope; failure never success-shaped

framework_profile.enforcement_model: per-surface: CLI gates fire in code w/ negative tests at real boundary; hooks block pre-tool; fizzy lane gates consumed via capability probes; judgment gates rubric+fixture
framework_profile.notes: profile_type=multi (R1 sol finding 2; bootstrap synced to target-architecture v5 at R4 fold — R4 sol finding 6 flagged this record as stale: it still declared single profile, request_response hook mapping, filelock 3.16.1, cryptography>=42). dimensions.name: execution model
dimensions.value: short-lived CLI invocations + hook subprocesses; no daemons in-slice (usage router external, §13)
dimensions.rationale: every new component is a CLI or hook check; BOOT-ROUTER advisory only

dimensions.name: config precedence
dimensions.value: spec-bound constants > repo files/registries > CLI flags; no env-var behavior switches for gates
dimensions.rationale: INV: behavior constants require spec bump + reconciliation (§7 MAX_PHASE_REGRESSION_POINTS, §12.2 press chars)

dimensions.name: error model
dimensions.value: named fail-closed enums + exit codes 0/1/2; failure output names check id + artifact + remediation
dimensions.rationale: spec §3 exit contract, §5.2 RemoteOperationResult/PromotionSequenceResult; kills the CON-001 class at new boundaries

dimensions.name: concurrency
dimensions.value: single-conductor assumed, never trusted: advisory locks + deterministic order + atomic replace on every state write
dimensions.rationale: spec §1 global protocol; CON-002/CON-007 show unlocked writes already bite

dimensions.name: I/O boundaries
dimensions.value: local blocking checks: repo files + attestations ONLY (no socket/DNS/HTTP/model/fizzy); REMOTE ops explicit and enumerated
dimensions.rationale: spec §5.2 no-network rule (SCOPE-1 relocation); hermetic split §3

dimensions.name: observability
dimensions.value: hash-chained JSONL event logs + envelope-wrapped reports + report identity (model id, versions, fixture-set hash)
dimensions.rationale: spec §10.2 event log, §7 report identity, §12 reconciliation reports

dimensions.name: testing
dimensions.value: 3-tier (pytest code / system-validation prompts / golden-eval LLM judgment); negative tests at real enforcement boundaries; REAL-DATA induced-live per Data Strategy
